form.descriptionHelp: Who it is for, what exists today and what you need next.

new.title: Share a project
new.sub: Tell builders nearby what you are making. Early is fine; a rough idea with a clear question gets the best feedback.
new.failed: We couldn't share your project. Your answers are still here; try again in a moment.

success.title: {name} is shared
success.body: Builders nearby can now read it and leave feedback. We'll tell you when the first comment arrives.

meta.title: Projects · Banaro
meta.description: Products in progress from Christian builders in Toronto and the GTA. Read what is being made, leave feedback, or offer a hand.

list.title: Projects made nearby
list.sub: {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} from builders in Toronto and the GTA. Read what is being made, leave feedback, or offer a hand.

search.label: Search projects
search.placeholder: Project, builder or what it does

pager.status: Showing {shown} of {total, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}

noResults.title: No projects match those filters
noResults.body: Try a wider stage, a different kind of help, or fewer words. Most projects are still early, so “Launched” is a narrow filter.

error.title: We couldn't load the projects
error.body: Banaro had trouble reaching the server. Nothing you shared has been lost. Try again, or browse builders while it recovers.

cta.text: Building something? Share it early; a first comment is often the most useful one.

empty.title: Be the first to say something
empty.body: {name} has no feedback yet. A question, a kind word or a small suggestion all help {owner} decide what to build next.

detail.emptyOwn: No comments yet. When someone leaves feedback, you will see it here.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that project
notFound.lead: It may have been renamed, removed by its builder, or the link might have a typo.

error.title: We couldn't load this project
error.body: Banaro had trouble reaching the server. The project and its feedback are safe. Try again, or go back to the showcase.

detail.heading: Project

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.sub: Changes appear on your project page as soon as you save.

failed.title: We couldn't save your changes
failed.body: Nothing was lost. Check your connection and try again.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Deleting {name} removes the project page and {count, plural, one {its # comment} other {its # comments}}. This can't be undone.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This permanently removes the project page and {count, plural, one {its # comment} other {its # comments}}. It can't be undone.
delete.removed: The project page is removed and its link stops working.
delete.offers: Offers to help on it are removed too.
delete.confirmLabel: Type the project name to confirm
delete.mismatch: That doesn't match. Type {name} exactly as shown.

failed.title: We couldn't delete {name}
failed.body: Banaro couldn't reach the server. Nothing was deleted, and what you typed is still here. Try again in a moment.

done.title: {name} deleted
done.body: The project and its comments are gone.

errors.required: Write a comment before posting. Even one sentence helps.
errors.min: Use at least {min} characters. A little more helps the builder act on it.
